summary: Missing PartialEq implementations prevented comparisons involving owned and borrowed string types from compiling. The fix adds those implementations and permits unsized AsRef<str> operands. This verbatim reversal restores the Sized restriction and removes equality between &CompactString and CompactString. The fix-added tests::test_eq_operator exercises these comparisons but only checks compilation, discarding comparison results. Reversal is therefore expected to prevent test compilation, which cannot satisfy the runtime-failure confirmation gate. No builds or tests were run.
